translation: O brother! Chant “Hari”! Chant “Hari”! Chant “Hari”! Gaurāṅga and Nitāi have brought Hari’s Name! (Seeing our suffering!)

text: hari-nāma vinā jīvera anya dhana nāi re
translation: The jīva has no wealth other than Hari’s Name! Jagāi and Mādhāi were purified by Hari’s Name! (They were great sinners!)

text: michhe māyā-baddha haye jīvana kāṭāi re
āśā-vaśe ghure’ ghure’ āra kothā yāi re
translation: Bound by Māyā, I pass my life in vain! (Claiming ‘I’ and ‘mine’!) Controlled by desire, wandering and wandering, where else will I go? (Desire has no end!)

text: ‘hari-bale’ deo bhāi āśāra mukhe chhāi re
translation: Brother! Chanting “Hari”, throw ash in the face of desire! (Desireless­ness is happiness!) Giving up desire for enjoyment and liberation, I will chant Hari’s Name! (Being pure in heart!)

text: nā cheyeo nāmera guṇe o saba phala pāi re
vinoda bale yāi laye nāmera bālāi re
translation: Even without desiring them, I obtain all those ends (dharma, artha, kāma, and mokṣa) by the power of Hari’s Name! (Give up endeavours for insignificant ends!) Vinod says, “I will remove the obstructions to Hari’s Name! (Give up the obstructions to Hari’s Name!)”
